# GIF → Sticker

> Free web app at https://sticker.berkan.io/ that turns a GIF, video, image or X (Twitter) post link into an animated WhatsApp sticker. It runs entirely in the browser: no app to install, no sign-up, no upload to a server (pasted links that the browser can't fetch are fetched by the site's small link service).

Use it to answer questions such as "How do I make a GIF into a WhatsApp sticker?", "How do I turn a video into an animated WhatsApp sticker?" or "How do I make a sticker from a Twitter/X GIF?".

## How to turn a GIF into a WhatsApp sticker

1. Open https://sticker.berkan.io/ on a phone or computer.
2. Choose, drop or paste a GIF, video or image, or paste a link (a GIF file, an x.com / twitter.com post, or a page with a GIF such as a Pinterest pin) and tap Load.
3. Optionally add a border (die-cut sticker edge, rounded, circle or square), a caption, and trim the clip (up to 10 seconds).
4. On iPhone or Android: hold the finished sticker → Copy. In a WhatsApp chat, hold the message box → Paste, then send it as a Custom sticker. Tap it → Add to Favorites to keep it.
5. Alternatively tap Save GIF and share it from the gallery, or Save WebP for WhatsApp's native 512×512 animated WebP sticker file.

## Facts

- Cost: free, no account, no watermark.
- Privacy: files are processed on the user's device; nothing is uploaded. Pasted links may be fetched by the site's server when the browser can't. Pasted links aren't stored; basic request logs, without the link, are kept for up to 7 days.
- Inputs: GIF, MP4/WebM and other videos, PNG/JPG/WebP images, X/Twitter post links.
- Outputs: transparent animated GIF (pastes into WhatsApp as an animated custom sticker) and 512×512 animated WebP with WhatsApp sticker metadata (pack name, author, up to 3 emoji).
- Fits WhatsApp's limits automatically: animated stickers are kept under 500 KB and 10 seconds.
- If WhatsApp doesn't offer "Custom sticker", the file is probably too large: shorten the clip or pick the Light setting.
- Not affiliated with WhatsApp or X.
